name: SnomedProstateExtension
title: SNOMED CT Prostate Extension
description: Local codes extending SNOMED CT for prostate-related clinical findings not yet available in SNOMED CT. To be used until adopted by SNOMED CT.

concept.definition: Normal consistency on digital rectal examination.
Flexible/elastic consistency on digital rectal examination.
Inflexible/rigid consistency on digital rectal examination.
Change is related to the primary prostate neoplasm (invasion, compression, or direct extension).
Change is not related to the prostate neoplasm (incidental or other etiology).
